goal: Let an owner pick the Named rival per location from that location's latest persisted Competitor pack, and have the Competitor Delta line honor the pick — including the dropout note and Auto-default rival fallback while the pick is absent.
non_goals: Per-keyword or multi-keyword rival picks (#532 defers multi-keyword presentation)
Account-level rollup of the Competitor Delta line (strictly per-location, #532 item 5)
Auto-unpick when a pick stays absent (#532 item 4: no auto-unpick in v1)
place_id-rotation continuity via data_cid / name+GPS matching (#532 item 4: accepted broken series)
Rating or rank-based gap math (#532 item 1: review-count gap only)
Fixing #572 item 1 (RankingTrackingWorker's divergent primary-keyword filter) or item 2 (unread rating plumbing) — RankingTrackingWorker stays out of the edit surface
Owner-facing editing of tracked_keywords / ranking_search_location (admin-set today)
A dashboard surface for the Competitor Delta (settings-only in v1)
user_visible_behavior: A new Settings > Responses > Competitors page lists, per active location, the location's latest Competitor pack as a dropdown for choosing the Named rival.

Dropdown options are the latest snapshot's pack rows excluding is_self and excluding rows with NULL/blank place_id, ordered by rank_position ASC NULLS LAST then place_id, each showing title, review count (em dash when NULL) and rating (em dash when NULL).
Rivals with a NULL review count are selectable (excluded from gap math only).
The first option is 'Auto-selected (nearest ahead)'; choosing it clears an existing pick and returns the location to the Auto-default rival.
A current pick that is absent from the latest pack is still shown as the selected entry, using the stored title snapshot, flagged 'not in the latest pack'.
Location with no primary tracked keyword or no search location: no dropdown, explanatory copy that competitor tracking is not configured for that location.
Location configured but with no persisted pack yet: no dropdown, teaser copy naming the keyword and saying the first pack lands after the next check.
Location whose latest pack contains no selectable rival: no dropdown, copy that no competitors were found in the latest pack.
Weekly Insights digest, owner pick present in the latest pack: the line renders with NO 'Auto-selected rival:' prefix, using the LIVE pack title.
Weekly Insights digest, no pick: unchanged from today — 'Auto-selected rival: <name> …'.

Weekly Insights digest, pick absent from the latest pack but present in the preceding snapshot: a dropout note '<stored title snapshot> dropped out of your local pack.' followed by the Auto-default rival line.
Weekly Insights digest, pick absent from both the latest and preceding snapshot (or only one snapshot exists): the Auto-default rival line only, no dropout note.
invariants: Tenant isolation: every read and write is scoped by account_id (from requireOwnerWithAccount) AND business_id; a businessId not owned by the caller's account returns 404.
The stored rival_title_snapshot is ALWAYS server-derived from the matched competitor_snapshots row — the client never supplies a display name that could reach a rendered email.
A pick is only accepted for a place_id present in that location's latest persisted pack and not is_self; anything else is rejected, never silently stored.
Gap = rival review_count minus our review_count; rating and rank never enter the gap (#532 item 1).
The Competitor Delta line is strictly per-location, computed from the location's primary (first) tracked keyword and its resolved search_location (#532 item 5).
A pick is never auto-removed (#532 item 4) — absence changes only which line renders.
Owner-picked rivals are never labeled 'Auto-selected'; the Auto-default rival is always labeled 'Auto-selected rival:' (CONTEXT.md Auto-default rival disclosure).
Invariant #1: no LLM/external/long-running work added to Next.js routes — the route does Postgres reads/writes only.
Invariant #13: no NEXT_PUBLIC_* companion is introduced; no new feature flag at all.
Invariant #15: src/lib/competitors/named-rival.ts receives its Sql client as an explicit parameter; only the route handler and the worker (composition roots) import the singleton.
The digest worker performs NO write to businesses — the dropout determination is derived, not stored.
Analytics: the pick event is inserted server-side and is NOT added to CLIENT_ENQUEUEABLE_EVENT_NAMES.
edge_cases: Pick submitted for a place_id that left the pack between page render and submit → 409 pack_refreshed, pick unchanged.
Pick submitted for the location's own is_self row → 409, never stored.
Pick submitted for a businessId belonging to another account → 404, no state change and no analytics event.
Pack row with NULL review_count picked → stored fine; the digest excludes it from gap math and falls through to the Auto-default line.
Pack rows with NULL/blank place_id → never offered as options (no stable identity to store).
Owner edits the tracked keyword or search location (admin action) → the pick's place_id is absent from the new series' pack; the derived dropout/fallback path handles it with no orphan state.
Only one snapshot date exists for the location and the pick is absent from it → Auto-default line, no dropout note (cannot distinguish first-absent from never-present).
Rival present in the pack but renamed since the pick → the digest uses the live pack title; the stored snapshot is only used for the dropout note and the settings UI's absent entry.
competitor_snapshots.rating is NUMERIC and returns from Postgres.js as a string → parsed on read in the shared module, never compared as a string.
snapshot_date is a DATE column → selected as ::text end-to-end (lab note: DATE-vs-string filter bug fixed in #570).
Archived location → not listed on the settings page.
Multi-location account → one row per active location, presentation decided by shouldUseMultiLocationSettings; single-location accounts see one dropdown with no location chrome.
Repeated biweekly snapshot pair across two weekly digests → the dropout note repeats, matching the already-accepted repeat of the velocity number (#539).

rollback_plan: Migration 089 has two parts. (a) Three nullable columns on businesses: additive, no constraint, no backfill, no data loss. (b) A DROP + re-ADD of analytics_events_event_name_check adding one name -- NOT additive in execution: it takes a brief ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock on analytics_events and re-validates existing rows (lock_timeout 5s). Roll back by reverting the application deploy: the columns go unread, the Competitor Delta line reverts to Auto-default-only behavior, and the widened CHECK is a superset of the old one so it is safe to leave in place. Drop columns only if the revert is permanent: ALTER TABLE businesses DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS rival_place_id, DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS rival_title_snapshot, DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS rival_picked_at. Apply order: staging Supabase first, then prod at promotion (lockstep).
observability: Durable analytics event competitor_rival_picked (properties: businessId, action set|cleared) inserted server-side by the route, dispatched by AnalyticsDispatchPoller — the probe-engagement signal the map asked for.
Structured worker log line competitor_delta_resolved from the digest recording which source rendered: owner_pick | auto_default | dropout | teaser | omitted.
Sentry via reportCaughtError on route failures, tagged with the route name and accountId (never the rival title).

How I'd know it broke: zero competitor_delta_resolved lines with source=owner_pick after picks exist in businesses, or a rise in 409 pack_refreshed responses indicating the pack refreshes faster than owners can submit.

2026-07-25 (Step 8 verify-gate repair, owner-approved): added vitest.config.ts. The gate's `test` row has been red across 8 runs from Postgres deadlocks and beforeAll/test timeouts among the 45 *.integration.test.ts suites, which re-apply migrations and DELETE from the same tables in parallel against ONE shared test database. Every failure is a deadlock or a timeout -- never an assertion -- and run single-threaded the suite is 782/782 files, 9568 tests green. This branch's own named-rival.integration suite is itself a victim (deadlock detected in its teardown DELETE) while the gate's ISOLATED row for that exact file PASSES, which is the contention proof. Fix is the documented Vitest projects recipe: a 'parallel' project excluding *.integration.test.ts and an 'integration' project including them with fileParallelism:false plus sequence.groupOrder, so only 45 of 783 files serialize. CI cost is ZERO -- those suites already skip in CI because TEST_DATABASE_POOL_URL is unset, which is exactly why CI never surfaced this. AMENDMENT COUNT: 3. Owner ruled this is test-harness repair, not product scope: it changes zero product behavior and fixes a pre-existing repo-wide defect (the #520 blind spot, demonstrated repo-wide) that this branch merely surfaced. Preferred over the blunt repo-wide fileParallelism:false, which would serialize all 783 files for no benefit on the 738 that never touch the database.
